title: Permutation invariance of the normalized sign sum
statement: For every natural number $n$, every permutation $\pi$ of the $n$ coordinates, and every sign vector $x\in\{−1,1\}^n$, the normalized sum of the coordinates of $x$ is unchanged when the coordinates are permuted by $\pi$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a permutation of the $n$ coordinates
$x$ is a sign vector of length $n$
